findings.description: The caption states 8 leaves of 0.114 x 2.400 x 0.018 m in mdf_solid and a total of 11.6 kg. The stated area density is 13.5 kg/m2, so those leaves weigh 30 kg between them: the slab mass has been computed for one leaf and then split across all 8. Every leaf is 8x too light.
findings.where: caption; the leaves in panels 1 and 2
